name: graph-uniswap
description: Simulate a Uniswap swap before making it — amount out, effective price and price impact, computed offline from The Graph with the protocol's own concentrated-liquidity math (wei-exact vs @uniswap/v3-sdk, no RPC). Plus pools, prices, pairs and swap flow across Uniswap V2/V3/V4 on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Optimism and BSC.
author: paulieb14
